B.label: production prompt plus existing C09 candidate rule

provider_and_transport.provider: Custom provider (local Ollama, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions)
provider_and_transport.credential_policy: The isolated CUSTOM row is seeded with api_key = NULL (explicitly empty). No provider key is loaded or sent; the compatibility probe and the live runs send no Authorization header.
provider_and_transport.provider_url_security: http only permitted for localhost/loopback; http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 is accepted and normalized.
provider_and_transport.runtime_model_binding: RoutingModelInferenceGateway freezes one provider/model target per Run; no retarget after freeze.
provider_and_transport.gateway_adds_path: The frozen Java gateway appends /chat/completions; the configured Base URL never contains it.

tooling_extension.reason: The existing P3-B live A/B harness hard-coded provider KILO and model cohere/north-mini-code:free, and the evaluator hard-coded the same expected provider/model. A minimal, backward-compatible extension was required to point the same frozen pipeline at a local Custom provider.
changes: EvalLiveIsolatedDatabase.seedCustomActivation(...): new seeding path that writes active_provider=CUSTOM plus a single custom_provider_settings row after the SAME isolated-database identity guard (no guard weakened).
EvalLiveHarnessBase.requireLiveProvider(...): added an explicit CUSTOM case reading CustomRuntimeSettings; unsupported providers are still rejected.

EvalLiveP3BDecisionQualityTest: provider/model/expected-model read from SPEC_AGENT_EVAL_P3B_PROVIDER and SPEC_AGENT_EVAL_P3B_CUSTOM_* env vars; defaults remain KILO + cohere/north-mini-code:free so historic behaviour is unchanged.

p3b_semantic_ab.py: EXPECTED_PROVIDER/EXPECTED_MODEL are now module-level constants with the original Kilo defaults, overridable via --expected-provider/--expected-model; a new --c09-only mode calls the UNCHANGED _decide_c09()/_pair_integrity() gate.

scenarios.frozen_facts: The user goal requires searching existing project information; memory.search is visible; scope=PROJECT is provided; required query is missing. Ask for the missing retrieval terms/query, do not ask again for scope, do not invent query text, and do not invoke the capability without query.

action_eligibility.configuration_source: SPEC_AGENT_ACTION_ELIGIBILITY_MODE=enforced for this test process; this matches the production default. The repository test profile otherwise defaults to shadow; shadow was NOT used for the frozen arms.

scoring.decision_rule: Use the existing C09 scorer unchanged. ACCEPT requires complete matching A/B input evidence, both B variants structurally and semantically correct with zero capability calls, measured improvement over fresh A, and fail-closed handling of any missing-query capability proposal. Missing or unresolved evidence remains INCONCLUSIVE; incorrect B evidence is REJECT.

stop_conditions: Stop the entire new experiment on the first HTTP 429.
Stop on authentication failure (including HTTP 401 or 403).
Stop on HTTP 502, any other upstream 5xx, connection failure, or provider-unavailable result.
Stop if any retry, fallback model, provider switch, or model change is observed.
Stop before any request that would exceed the global eight-request budget.
Record sent failed requests in the request budget.

runtime.flyway_migrations: Run by the existing Java test application's Flyway configuration against this dedicated database only. The user development database spec_agent was not touched by the evaluation.
runtime.chain: Java Host -> Python Brain -> Java Internal Model Broker -> CustomInferenceGateway -> Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1)

observed_deviations: Arm A was first measured under the repository test profile default SPEC_AGENT_ACTION_ELIGIBILITY_MODE=shadow (4 requests); that run was discarded as a setup error and is retained as arm-a-shadow-complete.json.
Two further Arm A attempts under enforced stopped on STATE_UPDATE model-contract failures (arm-a-enforced-contract-error-1/-2.json).

Arm B was attempted twice: the first stopped on a 90s inference TIMEOUT, the second on a CONNECTION failure. The frozen protocol permits max 2 attempts per arm but says never rerun a failed attempt; the second attempt is recorded as a deviation.
